title: Pre-fight Thai Oil massage, step by step
who: Kru Yai Jenypher Lanthier, York Muay Thai, with champion Matt Embree
summary: The full pre-fight rub-down a coach or cornerman gives a Muay Thai fighter, as taught by Grandmaster Ajahn Suchart: back, arms, legs, shins, chest and stomach, then wrapping the fighter up warm.
use_when: Fight day, cornering, coaches and gyms, anyone asking how to massage with Athlon Rub or Thai Oil, or a beginner who wants to see the tradition.

title: Soccer dynamic warm-up drills
summary: A demonstrated list of dynamic warm-up drills: arm rotations, high knees, butt kicks, A-skips, B-skips, front, side and back leg swings, straight-leg bounds, single-leg knee drives, squat jumps, shuffles, lunge with thoracic rotation, lunge with side bend, inside and outside hip openers, shuffle to lateral lunge, single-leg eccentric hamstring.
use_when: Soccer, rugby, football and other field sports, and any runner or team-sport athlete who wants to see the drills done.
